policy_text_full: Marriott's Best Rate Guarantee matches a lower publicly available rate within 24 hours of booking. Marriott Bonvoy membership is required. Bonus: lower rate plus $50 voucher OR 5,000 Bonvoy points. Strict identical-room rule applies.
